text: Over the past 30 days, some visitors have raised concerns about overcrowding, especially during school group visits, which limited access to exhibits. Several critical reviews focused on the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, with some feeling it detracted from the educational content and was not well integrated, including accessibility issues with kiosks. A few visitors noted a lack of depth in the historical interpretation, expressing a desire for more substantive information about Theodore Roosevelt’s accomplishments. Positive feedback often mentioned the interactive exhibits and architecture, but the balance between technology and historical content may need reevaluation. Food and beverage options and staff interactions received some attention but were less frequently mentioned.
